review.subtitle: Hamilton Khaki Field Murph 38 mm, white dial, black leather strap
notes: Front photo is the straight-on image you supplied (1650 x 2539 px).

Brushed case flank and lugs, the wide polished bezel and the polished crown are modelled; the leaf hour hand with its four lume petals, the minute hand with three lume segments and its needle point, and the seconds needle are modelled in polished steel and cream lume. The dial print and the leather come from the photo.
Heights are estimated from the listed 11.1 mm (no side photo); the domed crystal is built flat at its mean height.
